# Listings {#sec-appendix-tlf}

::: {.landscape}

```{r}
#| label: listing-sae

listing_serious_ae(adae) |>
  gt_nordvale() |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("Listing 16.2.7.1: Serious treatment-emergent adverse events"),
    subtitle = gt::md("Safety population")
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    gt::md("Onset day is relative to the first dose of study drug. One row per event.")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: listing-discontinuation

adsl |>
  dplyr::filter(COMPFL == "N") |>
  dplyr::arrange(TRT01P, USUBJID) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Subject = USUBJID,
    Treatment = as.character(TRT01P),
    `Age (years)` = AGE,
    Sex = as.character(SEX),
    `Treatment duration (days)` = TRTDURD,
    `End of study status` = stringr::str_to_sentence(EOSSTT)
  ) |>
  head(40) |>
  drop_labels() |>
  gt_nordvale() |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("Listing 16.2.1.1: Subjects who discontinued the study"),
    subtitle = gt::md("Randomised population, first 40 subjects")
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    gt::md("Listing truncated for the purposes of this demonstration.")
  )
```

:::
